{{Quote|They'll be safely stored in surgical plastic and implanted under the skin. My, ah, nurse can remove them on the other end.|Doctor Hope explains his innovative method of spice trafficking|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
"'''Doctor Hope'''" was the assumed name of a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he operated on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with his [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] nurse, [[Big Jan]]. To avoid Republic authorities, they smuggled the spice in small [[Spice ampoule|plastic ampoules]] implanted under the skin of their traffickers. When "Doctor Hope" was approached by [[Voidhound]] and [[Corso Riggs]] looking for information on Corso's cousin [[Rona Riggs]], he conned Corso into serving as a trafficker for one delivery in exchange for setting up a meeting with his kin.
